observation_summary: An ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException is thrown when calling MathArrays.linearCombination with arrays of length 1.
reasoning_summary: The code failed to handle the edge case where the input arrays have a length of 1. The implementation of 'linearCombination' assumed a minimum length of at least 2, as evidenced by the hardcoded access to 'prodHigh[1]' at line 846. When an array of length 1 was provided, this access triggered an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. The fix introduces a guard clause to check if the length is 1 and returns the simple product, preventing the invalid array access.
